Placed.au is looking for a full-time Marketing Coordinator for our client in Mulgrave, Victoria. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and managing the company's marketing strategy across brand development, digital marketing, events, partnerships, customer engagement, and e-commerce, while ensuring consistent brand presentation and supporting business growth.

Job Description
Brand & Creative Development

• Manage the company brand identity, ensuring consistency across packaging, point-of-sale materials, promotional assets, and marketing communications.

• Develop marketing collateral including catalogues, lookbooks, brochures, signage, and product information sheets.

• Coordinate product photography and video shoots to ensure visual content aligns with brand values and style.

• Maintain high standards of creative presentation across all digital and printed marketing materials.

Events, Partnerships & PR

• Plan and manage trade shows, pop-up stores, brand activations, and promotional events.

• Coordinate marketing support for wholesale partners, including cooperative advertising and joint campaigns.

• Assist with public relations initiatives, influencer outreach, and strategic collaborations to increase brand awareness.

• Represent the business professionally at external events while maintaining consistent brand messaging.

CRM, Email & Customer Engagement

• Build and manage customer communication campaigns to strengthen customer loyalty and retention.

• Develop automated email marketing campaigns, seasonal newsletters, and promotional communications.

• Analyse customer data to identify trends, segment audiences, and improve customer engagement.

• Support customer experience initiatives to ensure consistent branding across all customer touchpoints.

Digital Marketing & E-Commerce

• Manage and update Shopify website content, including product listings, promotional banners, and campaigns.

• Coordinate social media activity across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn by planning content, managing engagement, and curating posts.

• Manage digital advertising campaigns and monitor performance using Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, SEO, and other marketing tools.

• Prepare regular reports on website, campaign, and social media performance, providing data-driven recommendations for improvement.

Reporting, Administration & General Support

• Maintain the marketing calendar and coordinate project timelines across internal and external stakeholders.

• Monitor marketing budgets, supplier invoices, and campaign expenditure.

• Liaise with external suppliers and internal departments to ensure successful delivery of marketing initiatives.

• Support the sales, retail, and warehouse teams with marketing-related activities and events as required.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or at least five (5) years of relevant work experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

• Must possess at least one (1) year of relevant work experience in marketing coordination, brand management, or a similar marketing role.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to brand consistency and detail.

• Demonstrated experience coordinating marketing campaigns, events, promotional activities, and marketing collateral.

• Proficiency with Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and major social media platforms.

• Strong understanding of digital marketing, email marketing, SEO, and e-commerce principles.

• Excellent organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret marketing data and recommend improvements.

• Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable working independently in a small business environment.

• Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or Canva, apparel or lifestyle brands, photography, video editing, or B2B marketing will be highly regarded.

Salary Range

$70,000 – $85,000 per annum excluding superannuation.

result.description:
Concrete Support Services (CSS) is a fully independent concrete testing and engineering consultancy supporting construction projects right across Melbourne. From our laboratory and field operations, we deliver concrete testing, materials assessment and technical advice that builders, contractors and engineers rely on to keep their projects moving and compliant. Because we operate as a completely independent laboratory, our clients know that every result we issue is backed by integrity, confidentiality and impartiality. Our work aligns with Australian Standards and NATA requirements, and our team combines decades of hands-on concrete technology expertise with a genuine commitment to service. What sets us apart is speed paired with accuracy we understand that critical site activities can’t wait, so we go out of our way to turn around reliable field and laboratory results promptly and to consistently exceed what our clients expect. As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a motivated Civil Engineering Technician to join our team at Oakleigh South and play a hands-on role in delivering the quality and responsiveness our clients count on.

Key Responsibilities
•	Carry out and coordinate a full program of on-site and in-laboratory tests on concrete, construction materials and soils including sampling fresh concrete, casting and curing specimens, slump and compressive strength testing all in accordance with Australian Standards.
•	Interpret job briefs, project specifications and work assignment instructions, then apply the appropriate testing procedures and select the correct equipment for each task.
•	Record, collate and analyse test results, perform the associated computations, and enter data accurately and promptly into our laboratory data-management systems so clients receive fast, dependable results.
•	Prepare technical sketches, charts, tabulations and test reports that support civil engineering works such as roads, drainage, water supply and sewerage reticulation systems, dams and structural elements where concrete and materials testing is required.
•	Conduct site inspections of concrete and civil works, and help organise and oversee sampling, re-testing and remedial or maintenance verification where required.
•	Estimate material quantities and associated costs, and check that materials and finished works comply with specifications, regulations and relevant contract provisions.
•	Collect field data during site surveys and sampling runs including on road, pavement and infrastructure projects and consolidate it for analysis and reporting.
•	Calibrate, maintain and correctly operate field and laboratory testing equipment, and keep clear records of its condition and use.
•	Uphold the laboratory’s quality management system and safeguard the integrity, impartiality and confidentiality of every result, in line with NATA and Australian Standards requirements.
•	Liaise professionally with clients, site supervisors and project engineers, providing clear technical support and rapid feedback to accommodate critical site timelines.
•	Support concrete mix design and quality-control activities, contributing observations and data that help clients meet their construction project needs.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety procedures and contribute to a safe, well-organised working environment both on site and in the laboratory.

About You
•	Strong attention to detail and a methodical, accurate approach to testing and record-keeping.
•	Reliable, punctual and able to manage priorities to meet time-critical site demands.
•	A team player who communicates clearly and professionally with colleagues and clients.
•	Committed to integrity, impartiality and confidentiality in all aspects of the work.
•	Safety-conscious, with a genuine respect for standards, procedures and compliance.
•	Physically capable of the practical, hands-on aspects of field and laboratory testing.
•	Willing to learn, take direction and grow within a supportive, quality-driven team.

Qualifications & Experience
•	An AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant civil, engineering or materials-related discipline.
•	At least 1 year of relevant experience.

What We Offer
•	Salary:  $75,000 – $85,000 plus superannuation per annum.
•	Hours: Full-time position, typically 38 hours per week.
•	Location: Oakleigh South, VIC.

How to Apply
If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume together with a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and qualifications.

Principal Policy Officer (EL1 Equivalent)  
 
  Location:   Canberra, ACT; Sydney, NSW; Melbourne, VIC; Brisbane, QLD  
  Hourly Rate:   $83.00 - $91.73 / hr + Super  
  Contract Length:   Initial 10-month contract (Possibility of a 12-month extension), hybrid  
  Security Clearance:   Baseline Security Clearance (Mandatory)  
 
  About the Role  
  Randstad is currently partnering with a prominent Federal Government Department to recruit a specialist   EL1 Principal Policy Officer  .  
  In this role, you will join the team to support an expanded work program focused on Vocational Education and Training (VET) to Higher Education pathways and outcomes. You will deliver evidence-based analysis and policy advice, design analytical frameworks, and leverage administrative datasets to ensure targeted, policy-relevant outputs.  
  Key Responsibilities  
 
  Research & Policy Advice:   Conduct independent and team-based research and analysis on VET to Higher Education pathways and outcomes to produce high-quality, evidence-based policy advice.  
  Framework Design:   Develop a consistent definition of VET-to-Higher Education pathways and design/apply analytical frameworks to guide data analysis.  
  Data & Analytics Support:   Collaborate with data analysts, economists, and data scientists to support data reporting, publication activities, and complex analysis.  
  Stakeholder Engagement:   Undertake complex stakeholder engagement to inform work program deliverables.  
  Reporting & Governance:   Produce defensible, clear, and accessible documentation and reports while adhering strictly to procurement, privacy, and data governance obligations.  
 
  Key Selection Criteria  
 
  Sector Knowledge:   Strong understanding of VET and Higher Education data, systems, and the broader tertiary education sector.  
  Data & Frameworks:   Proven capability to design analytical frameworks and experience working with large administrative datasets (experience with the   Person Level Integrated Data Asset / PLIDA   is highly desirable).  
  Collaboration:   Demonstrated ability to work effectively within multi-disciplinary teams alongside economists, data scientists, and junior policy analysts.  
  Stakeholder Management:   Proven track record in undertaking complex stakeholder engagement and translating findings into policy-relevant deliverables.  
  Communication & Governance:   Experience producing high-quality, defensible reports while maintaining strict compliance with secure handling of sensitive data and data governance.  
 
  Eligibility Requirements  
 
  Must be an Australian Citizen.  
  Must hold a current, active   Baseline Security Clearance   at minimum.

result.description:
Target Business Services

Location: 581 Elderslie Rd, Broadmarsh, TAS 7030
Salary: $80,000 – $85,000 plus 12% superannuation.


Our client, GEARD, ELIZABETH JANE T/A PA & EJ GEARD, is a well-established farming enterprise specialising in cow farming and milk production, proudly operating in Tasmania’s vibrant agricultural sector. The business plays a vital role in supplying high-quality dairy products to local processors and distributors, ensuring sustainability and excellence at every stage of production. With deep roots in Tasmania’s farming community, the business upholds values of integrity, hard work, and commitment to animal welfare.

Through continuous improvement in farming practices and a strong focus on operational efficiency, PA & EJ GEARD has built a reputation for reliable and consistent dairy production. The business is committed to supporting regional development, providing employment opportunities, and maintaining the highest standards of milk quality and herd management.

We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Dairy Technician to support the efficient management of dairy production activities and livestock performance. The successful candidate will be responsible for assisting in herd management, monitoring animal health and nutrition, maintaining production standards, collecting and analysing farm data, and implementing improved dairy farming practices to maximise productivity and animal welfare.

This is a key position within the organisation and requires a strong understanding of dairy production systems, livestock management practices, and agricultural technologies. The role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute directly to the ongoing success and sustainability of a progressive Tasmanian dairy enterprise.

Qualifications and Experience

-	A Diploma or higher qualification in Agriculture, Dairy Production, Animal Science, Agricultural Technology, or a related field. Three years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications.
-	At least three years of relevant experience in dairy farming, livestock production, or agricultural operations.
-	Demonstrated knowledge of dairy herd management, animal nutrition, and milk production processes.
-	Experience in collecting, analysing, and maintaining farm production records and livestock data.
-	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and biosecurity practices in agricultural environments.

Key Responsibilities

-	Examine pasture, soil, and environmental conditions to determine their suitability for dairy production and identify factors affecting feed quality and livestock performance.
-	Assist in developing and implementing improved methods of pasture management, feeding programs, milking operations, and herd management to maximise productivity and land utilisation.
-	Monitor livestock health and identify diseases, parasites, and other conditions affecting dairy cattle, and assist in implementing appropriate control and treatment measures.
-	Analyse milk production and farm outputs to establish and maintain quality standards and production targets.
-	Inspect dairy cattle to evaluate the effectiveness of feeding programs, nutritional supplements, and herd management practices.
-	Assist in breeding and herd improvement programs aimed at enhancing milk production, animal health, and genetic performance.
-	Coordinate the supply and administration of veterinary drugs, vaccines, feed supplements, and agricultural chemicals, and provide advice on their appropriate use.
-	Collect, record, and analyse production, breeding, and animal health data to support farm planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
-	Assist in planning and coordinating milking schedules, feed management programs, livestock movements, and other aspects of dairy production operations.
-	Provide advice and recommendations to farm management regarding dairy production techniques, animal husbandry practices, and strategies to improve operational efficiency and sustainability.
-	Ensure compliance with animal welfare, biosecurity, workplace health and safety, and environmental regulations applicable to dairy farming operations.
-	Maintain accurate records relating to herd performance, milk yields, treatments, breeding activities, and farm production outcomes.

Skills and Attributes

-	Strong knowledge of dairy production systems and livestock management practices.
-	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
-	Ability to interpret production data and implement practical improvements.
-	Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with farm managers, veterinarians, and suppliers.
-	Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic farming environment.
-	Commitment to animal welfare, workplace safety, and continuous improvement.

To apply, please attach an up-to-date resume. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Please send your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au.
result.title: Dairy Technician

INVENTORY CONCEPTS
Pymble, Sydney, NSW 2073

Full Time Contract Administrator
SALARY:  $87,500 per annum plus superannuation 

Position 
The Contract Administrator is responsible for the administration, performance monitoring, and commercial management of all client contracts and fixed-rate service agreements across the business. The role plays a critical part in ensuring contractual compliance, maintaining profitability, protecting contract margins and compliance, and delivering operational efficiencies throughout the supply chain and logistics network. 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Contract Administration and Commercial Management 
•	Administer and manage all client contracts and fixed-price service agreements to ensure compliance with contractual obligations and service level requirements. 
•	Monitor contract performance, profitability, and operational outcomes against agreed contractual terms. 
•	Develop, review, negotiate, and implement contract variations, renewals, extensions, and service agreements. 
•	Identify and implement initiatives to improve contract profitability and operational efficiency. 
•	Maintain accurate contract documentation, pricing schedules, and commercial records. 
Financial Analysis and Business Improvement 
•	Analyse operational, financial, and performance data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for cost reduction and productivity improvements. 
•	Develop pricing models and costing structures for existing and prospective contracts. 
•	Prepare costing and pricing inputs for contract renewals, variations and client quotation responses. 
•	Conduct commercial analysis of contract performance to support contract negotiations, variations and renewals. 
•	Prepare forecasting data and performance reports to support future business planning. 
Client and Stakeholder Management 
•	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients. 
•	Act as a key point of contact for contractual matters and service-related issues. 
•	Ensure client expectations and contractual deliverables are clearly understood and consistently achieved. 
•	Support client retention initiatives and identify opportunities to expand service offerings within existing contracts. 
•	Participate in contract review meetings with clients, subcontractors and management. 
Supply Chain and Operational Coordination 
•	Work closely with logistics, warehouse, and inventory management teams to ensure contractual requirements are effectively delivered. 
•	Coordinate subcontractor performance to ensure service delivery standards, compliance requirements, and commercial objectives are achieved. 
•	Monitor operational performance against contractual KPIs and agreed service levels. 
•	Assist in the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across supply chain operations.
Contract Compliance, Risk and Reporting 
•	Analyse risks associated with specific contract terms and advise management on appropriate mitigation. 
•	Monitor relevant legislative, award and regulatory changes affecting contracts and coordinate with management and external advisers as required. 
•	Interpret and explain contract requirements, terms and conditions to internal stakeholders, clients and subcontractors to support compliance. 
•	Maintain and improve contract-management systems and records, including the in-house platform, to support accurate and efficient contract administration. 
•	Assist in the preparation and negotiation of contract terms, renewals and variations with clients and subcontractors. 

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERIENCE 
•	Demonstrated experience in contract administration, commercial management, or supply chain contract management. 
•	Strong financial and commercial acumen with the ability to analyse costs, profitability, and operational performance. 
•	Experience within logistics, warehousing, inventory management, third-party logistics (3PL), or supply chain environments. 
•	Sound understanding of fixed-price service agreements, contract compliance, and service level management. 
•	Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and maintain strong client relationships. 
•	Experience in pricing analysis, contract negotiation, and the administration of contract variations and renewals. 
•	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with advanced data interpretation capabilities. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	High-level computer literacy and proficiency in business systems, reporting tools, and data analysis software. 
•	Knowledge of warehouse operations, distribution centres, inventory control, container handling, and material handling equipment (MHE). 
•	Demonstrated understanding of Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements within 
•	logistics and distribution environments. 
•	Relevant qualifications in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations 
•	Management, Information Technology, or a related discipline at AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma level or above. 
•	A demonstrable track record in WHS and its applications in fast paced and dynamic distribution facilities. 


Applications open on 24 July 2026 and close on 23 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.
